name: restart_syscall
description: The restart_syscall() system call restarts certain system calls after a process is interrupted by a stop signal and then resumed. It adjusts time-related parameters for specific calls like poll(2), nanosleep(2), and others, and is intended for internal kernel use only.

return_value.success: Returns the value of the restarted system call
return_value.failure: Returns the error value of the restarted system call, with errno set accordingly

errors.description: errno is set according to the errors of the restarted system call
